title: External dataset source manifest
description: Metadata and byte-level provenance for an external dataset or satellite granule stored outside Git.

logical_name.description: Human-readable name of the dataset or granule (not just a filename).

source.description: Persistent DOI or upstream URL from which the archive or granule is obtained.

discovered_via.description: Landing page, data descriptor DOI, or tutorial URL when distinct from the download source.

license.description: Upstream license or terms of use (e.g., CC-BY-4.0, NASA-Open-Data).

version_string.description: Version declared by the file or archive metadata itself. Use 'not declared' if absent and explain in notes; never guess from a folder name.

record_count.description: Expected or locally verified observation/pixel-position count (with provenance noted in notes when digest_verified is false), else null.

retrieved_utc.description: Valid calendar UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) when retrieved on working storage, or null if not yet staged locally.

bytes.description: Exact byte size when verified on local storage, else null.

sha256.description: Expected or locally recomputed lowercase SHA-256 hex digest.

digest_verified.description: True ONLY after recomputing sha256 against the local file staged for this checkout. False when carried forward from prior notes or upstream documentation.

local_path_key.description: Key in gitignored config/local_paths.yaml pointing to the local file or directory, keeping machine-specific paths out of Git.

used_by.description: Scripts, notebooks, or experiment IDs consuming this dataset.

notes.description: Required caveats and properties the file does NOT declare about itself (e.g., sampling skew, NRT status, target circularity, unmeasured flag columns).

example.description: True only on the worked template record, which validators must refuse as real evidence.
